reason: S24 06/11 21:59: 'paie ma facture SONEDE de 19,400 DT' reached samantha_sonede (reads only) then samantha_catalogue and answered 'route non active'; since brain-only (02/11) no typed tool carried a payment. The playbooks side is samantha-ui-playbooks payment-brain-handoff-20261106; without this change the catalogue validation would reject the whole projection.
